versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Board Deck Narrative skill.
- Provides complete slide-by-slide structure, talking points, and narrative guidance for board presentations.
- Asks for all key board meeting inputs to tailor the deck: company context, meeting type, themes, metrics, needed decisions, timing, and audience.
- Ensures each slide includes narrative context, actionable takeaways, and board-relevant framing.
- Includes best practices, quality checks, and anti-patterns to ensure effective board communications.
- Covers all typical board deck sections: Opening, Business Performance, Strategy, People, Financials, Priorities & Asks, and Appendix.
